attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 original small card is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides mascot identity and anatomy only. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the actual source character kind: a serious figure with a closed mouth, short grey temple hair, real brow hair, and a clean upper lip and chin with no moustache or beard. Retain the actual KHAKI/OLIVE-BROWN peaked naval cap with a wide crown, dark band and visor, thin gold trim, and a small source-visible pale/silver central motif. Preserve the actual primary image-left mild angle and head roll, cap geometry, lighting, and crop. Maintain the KHAKI/LIGHT TAN open folded shirt or uniform collar with a dark necktie, noting only small source-exposed shoulder and fastening areas without inventing a dark navy coat or hidden medals. Ensure the rounded chin immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Avoid separate yellow neck shafts, pointed V funnels, pinched collars, neck rolls, floating collars, clipping, or cream belly bibs. Preserve the actual open or closed garment state and fastening with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual source color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. Keep all solid surfaces opaque with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details indistinct and understated, particularly the eye-rim area where no prominent spectacles should be added.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Actual KHAKI/OLIVE-BROWN peaked naval cap with wide crown, DARK band/visor, thin GOLD trim and small source-visible PALE/SILVER central motif. Short GREY temple and real brow HAIR, clean upper lip/chin with no moustache/beard, serious CLOSED mouth. Primary fine eye-rim detail genuinely indistinct: no invented prominent spectacles. KHAKI/LIGHT TAN OPEN folded shirt/uniform collar with DARK necktie and only note-limited small source-exposed shoulder/fastening areas; no dark navy coat or hidden medals. Preserve actual primary IMAGE-LEFT mild angle/head roll, cap geometry, light and crop.
Preserve actual real hair and eyebrow HAIR and source-matching mouth. One compact near-round yellow head with clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately resting on raised/broadened existing collar; very short broad transition, no human long neck/angular jaw, pointed V lower-face funnel, shaft, pinched collar, rolls, floating cloth, clipping or cream belly bib. Keep exact source lighting, frame/backing/note and all dark clothes opaque. Image1 exact original card; Image2 user mascot identity/anatomy only. Fine ambiguous details stay understated, no invented symbols, readable text, labels, watermark, extra figures or comparison sheet.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged small primary, full raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan/alpha panels, larger opposite-angle context used only for appearance. Keeps actual primary image-left angle, khaki-brown peaked cap/dark band and visor/pale motif, grey temple and eyebrow hair, clean serious closed mouth, khaki open folded shirt collar/dark tie and limited shoulder fitting. Yellow lower face tapers to a long pointed V above the tie instead of compact rounded short chin against a raised broad collar. Separate exact-master builtin geometry repair preserving cap, original angle, clothing and lighting. Fine eye-rim ambiguity does not justify new prominent glasses. Opaque backing/frame/note and shirt show no internal alpha holes.
